_doc: Generated ordinary shops and workshops (ADR-0030, BuildingGenerator): tier-1 filler for commercial and industrial lots without an authored pick. Slab-on-grade, flat or low roofs.

defs.name: Corner store
stories: {family}'s chained the front doors when the shelves ran low and sold out of the back. The stock room door has been shut since.
Looters came through the window at {family}'s and found the owner had beaten them to the canned goods.

defs.name: Workshop
stories: {family} chained the bay doors and kept working on the generator in the back. Whatever he was fixing, he never finished.
The {family} boys holed up in the tool crib with a radio and a crate of shells.
